topic: Model Context Protocol (MCP) — connecting AI assistants to your data
coherence_note: Every factual sentence in the script maps to one of two primary sources (Anthropic's official announcement and the official MCP site). No entity appears that is not named in a source. The story is one coherent subject: what MCP is, why it exists, how client/server works, which pre-built servers exist, and what it enables.

sources.title: What is the Model Context Protocol?

claims.exact_claim: AI assistants are constrained by their isolation from data — trapped behind information silos and legacy systems.
claims.source_quote: Yet even the most sophisticated models are constrained by their isolation from data... Every new data source requires its own custom implementation...
claims.supporting_evidence: Anthropic's official announcement states frontier models are constrained by isolation from data and that every new data source requires a custom implementation.
claims.script_sentence: AI assistants are trapped behind information silos.

claims.exact_claim: MCP is a universal, open standard for connecting AI systems with data sources.
claims.source_quote: MCP addresses this challenge. It provides a universal, open standard for connecting AI systems with data sources, replacing fragmented integrations with a single protocol.
claims.supporting_evidence: Anthropic's announcement describes MCP as a universal, open standard replacing fragmented integrations with a single protocol.
claims.script_sentence: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol is one open standard connecting AI to your data.
claims.visual_opportunity: Article-highlight card with marker stroke over 'one open standard', source URL on card.

claims.exact_claim: Developers either expose their data through MCP servers or build AI applications (MCP clients) that connect to these servers.
claims.source_quote: developers can either expose their data through MCP servers or build AI applications (MCP clients) that connect to these servers.
claims.supporting_evidence: The official MCP site defines the server/client roles explicitly.
claims.script_sentence: An MCP server exposes your data; an MCP client like Claude connects to it.
claims.visual_opportunity: Animated diagram: MCP client node -> connector -> MCP server node -> data sources.

claims.exact_claim: MCP works like a USB-C port for AI applications — one standard port instead of a custom connector per data source.
claims.source_quote: Think of MCP like a USB-C port for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.
claims.supporting_evidence: The official MCP site uses the USB-C analogy for the protocol.
claims.script_sentence: Think of it like USB-C for AI — one port instead of a custom connector for every data source.
claims.visual_opportunity: USB-C-style connector icon next to the diagram (original graphic, labelled illustrative).

claims.exact_claim: Anthropic shares pre-built MCP servers for popular enterprise systems including Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Git, Postgres and Puppeteer.
claims.source_quote: We're sharing pre-built MCP servers for popular enterprise systems like Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Git, Postgres, and Puppeteer.
claims.supporting_evidence: Anthropic's announcement lists the pre-built servers by name.
claims.script_sentence: Pre-built MCP servers exist for Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Postgres and Puppeteer.
claims.visual_opportunity: Terminal insert typing an MCP stdio server config; server names listed on screen.

claims.exact_claim: MCP enables building once and integrating everywhere, giving AI systems access to the data where it lives.
claims.source_quote: ...making it easy to build once and integrate everywhere... AI assistants... can connect to data sources... and perform tasks.
claims.supporting_evidence: The official MCP site describes broad ecosystem support and 'build once and integrate everywhere'.
claims.script_sentence: Build once, integrate everywhere. AI finally reaches your data.
claims.visual_opportunity: Summary card; diagram settles to stable center composition with credits.
